description: Check whether a specific version of a software product is end-of-life (EOL). Returns lifecycle status, the EOL date, days remaining or days past EOL, the latest release, and eol_date_source (where the date comes from: vendor-override, vendor-fetched, vendor-verified, custom, upstream, or discrepancy) with its source URL. Use this for "is X version Y still supported?" questions.
name: check_eol
title: Check end-of-life status
